svg.title: GE9X engine cutaway
svg.desc: Educational drawing of the GE9X architecture: a 16-blade composite fan, 3 booster stages, 11 high-pressure compressor stages, an annular combustor, 2 high-pressure turbine stages, and 6 low-pressure turbine stages. A shorter bypass cowl surrounds the forward engine, leaving the aft core exposed. An inner low-pressure shaft and an outer high-pressure shaft connect their respective rotors. Flow paths and non-fan blade counts are illustrative. Cutaway drew this model from public references without manufacturer CAD.

g.aria-label: Cutaway fan case and shorter bypass cowl
Core exhaust nozzle and tail cone
Concentric shafts: inner LP shaft connects fan, booster and low-pressure turbine; outer HP shaft connects compressor and high-pressure turbine
Outer high-pressure shaft, compressor to high-pressure turbine
Inner low-pressure shaft, fan and booster to low-pressure turbine
Separate bypass and core airflow paths
